definitions.explanation: The systematic process of training and developing people to acquire specific skills or qualifications over time. Used for professional development and education.

examples.japanese: {教師|きょうし}を{養成|ようせい}する。
{人材|じんざい}{養成|ようせい}に{力|ちから}を{入|い}れている。
examples.english: We are putting effort into developing human resources.

examples.japanese: この{大学|だいがく}には{看護師|かんごし}{養成|ようせい}コースがある。
examples.english: This university has a nursing training course.

notes:
{養成|ようせい}する functions as a suru-verb meaning "to train" or "to develop."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人材|じんざい}を{養成|ようせい}する (develop human resources)
- {養成|ようせい}コース (training course)
- {養成|ようせい}{講座|こうざ} (training program)
- {養成|ようせい}{所|じょ}/{養成|ようせい}{機関|きかん} (training institution)

Specifically refers to training people (not skills or things). Not to be confused with {要請|ようせい} (request/demand), which is a homophone with different kanji and meaning.
